references.text: The Levites were gathered in front of the tabernacle when they were consecrated for service.
The Israelites laid their hands on the Levites as part of the consecration ceremony before the tent of meeting.
Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did what the Lord commanded concerning the Levites.
The Levites were brought forward to Aaron and consecrated for service at the tent of meeting.
Aaron and his sons were brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting for consecration.
Description of the consecration ceremony where the priests were brought before the tent of meeting.
The Levites were to camp around the tabernacle and serve it.
